backend.framing: Entirely backend-owned; gzip members restart native Decompress only after StreamEnd. No handwritten header/checksum/parser.
backend.gzipMetadata: Native pinned zlib-rs default: mtime0, no optional fields, OS19 macOS/10 Windows/3 other, XFL dependent on level; assert default header and repeat identical operations byte-for-byte. No public header options. Replaces the unexecuted bufread 10-byte workaround.
backend.whyAlternative: miniz bufread API has no Sync flush; write wrappers finalize on Drop. Safe low-level gzip constructors require any_zlib, admitted zlib-rs exposes them without custom framing, unsafe code, leaked state, hidden executor or altered pool lifetime.

ownership.pool: Explicit existing weak PoolSubmission only; owned bounded work steps, one active codec and reusable input/output owners; no async I/O on CPU worker.
ownership.cancellation: Recovery restores owned codec/buffers on queued cancellation or dropped successful completion. Existing scope cleanup joins actual CPU settlement and releases capacity before publication. Destination borrowed slices never enter CPU jobs.
ownership.sinkCancellation: A cancelled async sink operation can have unreported effects; poison writer rather than replay possibly written output.
ownership.drop: Plain Compress/Decompress destruction releases allocations without stream finish; unfinished output remains unfinished. Owner and buffer-drop/strong-count witnesses after explicit pool shutdown; no implicit compression or admission.
ownership.finish: Signal actual input EOF, drain backend StreamEnd and validate trailers/checksums/truncation before returning underlying B05 owner. Decoder accepts concatenated gzip; raw/zlib reject trailing data.
ownership.flush: Native Sync, bounded drain and B05 flush; no EOF. Verify prefix decodes immediately, remains non-StreamEnd, second write continues same stream.
ownership.policy: Optional maxOutput counts incrementally with one-byte over-limit probe; ordinary decoding has no total cap. Working buffer8192 reused from B05, not output limit.
